item.title: Will Netflix's $82.7B deal for Warner Bros. clear the regulatory gauntlet?
item.description: Netflix has inked an $82.7 billion deal to acquire WBD's studio and streaming business but is likely to face some tall regulatory hurdles. Paramount Skydance's David Ellison has reportedly caused some static at the White House.

item.title: Lumen appoints Jim Fowler as Chief Technology & Product Officer
item.description: Fowler will report to Lumen CEO Kate Johnson and will be responsible for Lumen's global technology and product strategy. #pressrelease

item.title: Intel networks U-turn is a relief for Ericsson and Samsung
item.description: A sale of Intel's NEX business always looked unviable and threatened to upset one or more of its biggest 5G customers.

item.title: Eurobites: Danish duo merge to target 5G NTN market
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: bereaved family calls Vodafone's franchisee policy into question; Deutsche Telekom nuzzles up to Nvidia for 5G cloud gaming; X fined €120 million for checkmark failings and more.

item.title: EchoStar to FCC: 'Severe uncertainty' led to spectrum sales
item.description: EchoStar told the FCC that it did not want to sell spectrum, but said it did so due to uncertainty fueled by the FCC's investigation. Elsewhere, AT&T said it views EchoStar's 600MHz holdings as a possible 'anchor band' for 6G.

item.title: Harmonic to sell video biz to MediaKind for $145M
item.description: More than a year after taking its video business off the block, Harmonic announced Monday that it has struck a deal to sell that portion of its business to fellow video tech specialist MediaKind for $145 million in cash.

item.title: Paramount mounts hostile bid for Warner Bros. Discovery
item.description: Challenging Netflix's proposed deal for Warner Bros. Discovery's studios and streaming biz, Paramount Skydance has launched a hostile cash bid that values all of WBD at $108 billion.

item.title: DirecTV launches app for LG smart TVs
item.description: DirecTV said it has introduced an app for LG smart TVs from 2021 and newer that run on webOS 6.0 or higher. #pressrelease

item.title: Cellular IoT connections to reach 5.9B by 2035 – Omdia
item.description: Study identifies three technologies as primary growth drivers: 5G RedCap, 5G Massive IoT and 4G LTE Cat-1bis modules. #pressrelease

item.title: SpaceX files for 'Starlink Mobile' trademark
item.description: In another hint about its cellular-terrestrial future, SpaceX has filed for a 'Starlink Mobile' trademark. SpaceX's true interest will surface if it participates in the upper C-band auction, says Recon Analytics' Roger Entner.
